# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP. It adds variable-font and color-font support, animated WebP encoding, and reworks the singleton lifecycle and default-typeface resolution. This is a breaking release with several behavioral and Vulkan interop changes — read the breaking changes below before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **new SKFont() now has an empty typeface** — Compiles unchanged but MeasureText/drawing on a default-constructed SKFont now uses an empty (0-glyph) typeface instead of lazily resolving the platform default, so measured widths silently become 0. Construct with an explicit typeface (e.g. new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)) and use Typeface.IsEmpty instead of a null check.
- **new SKPaint().Typeface returns Default instead of null** — SKPaint.Typeface is now always non-null (SKTypeface.Default) rather than null. Text still renders correctly, but code that used a null check to detect "no typeface set" no longer fires — use Typeface.IsEmpty instead.
- **SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing") no longer returns null on Android** — All platforms are now consistent: an unknown family returns SKTypeface.Default instead of null on Android. For a strict "was it found" check, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily, which still returns null on no match.
- **SKStream.Move(long) now throws and is obsolete** — The long overload used to silently truncate out-of-range offsets to a 32-bit int; it now throws OverflowException and is marked [Obsolete]. Call Move(int) with a validated, in-range offset instead.
- **GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null** — Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1 and calls SK_ABORT (terminating the process, not throwing) if the instance or backend context declare only 1.0. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on both the VkInstance's apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion (do not leave MaxAPIVersion at its default 0) before calling CreateVulkan.
- **GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five interop fields** — fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed from this interop struct. Delete those assignments; use fVkExtensions instead of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 instead of fFeatures. There is no replacement for fOwnsInstanceAndDevice.
- **GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped and lost value-equality** — The property now returns GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (with a new Components field) instead of the old GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo, which also lost its IEquatable implementation and equality operators. Update field-layout-dependent code and replace equality comparisons with manual field comparisons.

## Engine

- **Skia updated through milestones 132 to 148** — Bumps the bundled Skia engine across milestones 132, 133, 147, and finally 148, merging several rounds of upstream chrome/m147 bug fixes along the way — the biggest engine jump since v3. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))

## API Surface

- **Variable and color font support** — Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, color font palette selection, and improves variable font robustness overall. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Animated WebP encoding** — Adds SKWebpEncoder support for encoding animated WebP images. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **Zero-copy stream-to-data conversion** — Adds SKStream.GetData() to convert a stream to SKData without an intermediate copy. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **HBColor and other missing API wrappers** — Adds an HBColor struct for the proper hb_color_t representation, plus several other missing API wrappers and naming-convention fixes. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **SKSamplingOptions support extended to surface drawing** — SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface now accept SKSamplingOptions. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **Legacy paint/font APIs promoted to errors** — Obsoletes the remaining legacy SKPaint text/font state-reading members and promotes them (and other pre-v4 obsoletes) from warnings to compile errors, completing the v3-to-v4 obsolete-API cleanup. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel access stride and offset fixes** — SKPixmap/SKBitmap.GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride instead of the pixel width, and the generic GetPixelSpan<T>(x, y) overload no longer uses Height where Width was needed. ([#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148), [#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128))
- **SKPath finalizer crash fixed** — Fixes a finalizer crash in SKPath when its SKPathBuilder is collected first. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9** — Fixes a packaging issue that left the WinUI Projection DLL missing for .NET 9 consumers. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **MAUI TabBar rendering fix on Android** — Fixes SKGLView not rendering after a tab switch inside a MAUI TabBar on Android. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **Default-typeface resolution moved to the managed layer** — Moves default-typeface resolution into managed code, fixing inconsistent behavior across platforms (including Android API 36+). — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle reworked** — Reworks how SkiaSharp's singleton native instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compatibility gate from a module initializer into the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup ordering. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080), [#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Broader native platform coverage** — Adds Linux Bionic native assets, x64/arm64 Tizen native builds, and corrects Apple TFMs (26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps). — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620), [#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — Updates the bundled zlib, libpng, libexpat/expat, libjpeg-turbo, freetype, and harfbuzz to their latest releases, picking up upstream security and bug fixes. ([#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Updates the bundled HarfBuzz binding to 14.2.0, adding variable font shaping support and the new HBColor struct alongside the SkiaSharp v4 upgrade.

## Release Candidate 1 (June 12, 2026)

The release candidate updates Skia to milestone 148, fixes the pixel-span stride/offset bugs, promotes the remaining legacy paint/font obsoletes to compile errors, and updates harfbuzz to 14.2.0, finalizing the first stable v4 release.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.147.0-preview.3.1...v4.148.0-rc.1.2)
